title: Run the pre-publication clean-room v1.0 rehearsal
description:
A pristine reviewer-authorized run authenticates the immutable candidate prerelease and rehearses all exact escrowed native, source, MCP, OCI, evidence, and frozen-document bytes while every final v1 channel remains absent.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: workflow_dispatch accepts only candidate_escrow_release_id plus expected root digest and no ref/name/latest selector. Read-only verification fetches that numeric release, candidate tag/peeled SHA, release attestation and exact numeric asset IDs/digests from its recovery bundle, rejects any missing/mutable/mismatched identity, and downloads every tested byte directly from release assets—not Actions artifacts.
- [hard] REQ-02: Extracted native candidates install cleanly and verify jit version/init, accepted profile quickstart, human and --json commands, jit --schema, jit-server, real embedded web/SPA fallback, and /api/health.
- [hard] REQ-03: In a separate pristine environment, the exact source archive checksum/provenance/inventory are verified and extracted without Git metadata; frozen source instructions and cargo install --path crates/jit --locked pass without changing the archive.
- [hard] REQ-04: The exact retained MCP tarball is integrity/provenance-verified, clean-installed, and completes initialize/tools-list with candidate jit; public npm 1.0.0 remains absent, with no publish/repack command.
- [hard] REQ-05: OCI tar SHA-256/D_index match escrow evidence; Skopeo copies D_run digest-preservingly into rootless Podman, and exact runtime bytes pass default/host-UID lifecycle, API/web/document/search/persistence/ownership smoke. With a ten-second stop timeout, multiple SSE and a deliberately non-completing ordinary connection remain active at SIGTERM; SSE reaches EOF, the handle force-closes the stall at five seconds, and PID 1 exits 0 before ten seconds without SIGKILL/137 or archive mutation.
- [hard] REQ-06: Frozen binary/source install, deployment, upgrade, checksum/provenance, compatibility, profile quickstart, and package-candidate instructions execute with commands, versions, checksums, package integrity, image digest, and results retained.
- [hard] REQ-07: Before/after rehearsal, the exact immutable candidate prerelease remains present while public npm 1.0.0, v1.0.0 tag/final GitHub Release, and GHCR :1.0.0 remain absent; rehearsal has no tag/registry/release/source-write permission.
- [hard] REQ-08: Acceptance inventories CLI, server/API, web UI, MCP server, escrowed native/source/MCP candidates, and OCI image; it verifies core/profiles Done contracts and quickstart.
- [hard] REQ-09: Success uploads/attests one 90-day rehearsal-completed artifact containing candidate release numeric ID/URL, every asset ID/digest, root digest, release attestation, commands/results, core/profile acceptance, and final-channel snapshot. Final authorization accepts only this ID and reauthenticates escrow; failure/day-60/expiry/abandonment prevents final tag.

## Notes

Blast radius: read-only clean-room acceptance from public immutable candidate escrow plus one attested rehearsal artifact; defects return to their source owner before final-v1 identity.
